raw.overview: All three advisors concur that the relocation package's $18,000 gross amount—comprising $10,000 stipend and $8,000 reimbursement—is fully taxable at the user's 35% marginal rate, resulting in $6,300 in taxes and $11,700 net cash, which falls short of the $14,000 required liquidity threshold.
raw.points_of_note: The advisors uniformly identify the $11,700 net after-tax figure as violating the >=$14,000 constraint, with Advisor 1 explicitly flagging the shortfall and requesting verification of potential gross-up structures, while Advisors 2 and 3 similarly note the deficit and suggest checking for non-taxable components or structural alternatives that might adjust the taxable base.
raw.suggested_next_step: Verify whether the employer offers any tax gross-up or alternative compensation structure to elevate net after-tax liquidity to at least $14,000 before proceeding.

consensus.text:
ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: All three advisors concur that the relocation package's $18,000 gross amount—comprising $10,000 stipend and $8,000 reimbursement—is fully taxable at the user's 35% marginal rate, resulting in $6,300 in taxes and $11,700 net cash, which falls short of the $14,000 required liquidity threshold.
POINTS OF NOTE: The advisors uniformly identify the $11,700 net after-tax figure as violating the >=$14,000 constraint, with Advisor 1 explicitly flagging the shortfall and requesting verification of potential gross-up structures, while Advisors 2 and 3 similarly note the deficit and suggest checking for non-taxable components or structural alternatives that might adjust the taxable base.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: Verify whether the employer offers any tax gross-up or alternative compensation structure to elevate net after-tax liquidity to at least $14,000 before proceeding.

shared_ground: Total gross relocation value is $18,000 ($8,000 reimbursement + $10,000 stipend)
Net after-tax cash is $11,700 calculated as $18,000 * (1 - 0.35)

cruxes.side_a: All $18,000 gross relocation amount is taxable W-2 compensation with no gross-up
cruxes.side_b: Potential non-taxable components may exist in the $18,000 total
cruxes.premise_at_stake: Whether non-taxable portions reduce the taxable base below $18,000

unverified_premises: Whether any portion of the $18,000 relocation package is excluded from taxable income for payroll withholding
raw.decisive_check: Does the $18,000 total taxable amount include any non-taxable components that should be excluded from the 35% payroll withholding calculation?
